nodes.name: Hypoxia Response Protocol
nodes.text: SYNTHETIC: NOT REAL MEDICAL PROCEDURE. Restore O2 supply. Move affected crew to safe volume. Apply supplemental O2. Monitor SpO2 continuously. Target SpO2 > 95%.

nodes.name: Radiation Shelter Protocol
nodes.text: Move crew to radiation shelter. Reduce EVA activities. Monitor cumulative dose. Resume normal operations when dose rate returns to baseline.

nodes.name: Rapid Decompression Response
nodes.text: SYNTHETIC: NOT REAL MEDICAL PROCEDURE. Don emergency suits immediately. Seal affected compartment. Initiate emergency repressurization. Check all crew for decompression symptoms.
